newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut shares steady in lower turnover.
newsitem.headline: Beirut shares steady in lower turnover.

text.p: All shares held steady in reduced turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Wednesday.

Turnover in bank shares fell sharply to 15,150 Banque Audi and 15,706 Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares from 40,414 and 41,000 respectively on Tuesday. The BLC activity included a 10,000-share block trade.
Audi and BLC were unchanged at $17.25 and $12.625 respectively.
Solidere was also unchanged with A shares at $10.5 and B shares at $10.875. Some 57,136 shares changed hands, down from 71,621 on Tuesday.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Uniceramic and Eternit.
Total BSE turnover was 87,992 shares for a value of $1,060,855 compared with Tuesday's 138,035 shares for a value of $1,783,060.
The BLOM index was unchanged at 908.62 and the LISPI stock index was also steady at 81.66.
"The LISPI was unchanged at 81.66 as the price of all the stocks listed on the BSE were stable," Lebanon Invest Research Company, which compiles the index, said in its daily bulletin.
